name: GUI Input Capture
summary: Adversaries may mimic common operating system GUI components to prompt users for sensitive information with a seemingly legitimate prompt. The operating system and installed applications often have legitimate needs to prompt the user for sensitive information such as account credentials, bank account information, or Personally Identifiable Information (PII). analytics.guidance: For Android, detect GUI Input Capture by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed.
